claim: OpenAI's bespoke `Sofic` definition is satisfiable: the trivial group is sofic. (If it weren't, 'there is a non-sofic group' would be trivially true.)
lean:
theorem probe_trivial_sofic : SoficGroups.Sofic (Multiplicative Unit) := by
  constructor
  intro F ε hε _
  refine ⟨⟨1, one_pos, fun _ => 1, rfl⟩, ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro g _ h _
    simpa [SoficGroups.normalizedHamming] using hε
  · intro g _ hg
    exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim g 1) hg
